sources: General DOR remote seller guidance patterns

register_sales_tax.title: Register for Sales Tax — {state_name}
register_sales_tax.summary: If you have physical nexus (FBA inventory) or economic nexus in {state_name}, you may need to register for a sales tax permit with the state's Department of Revenue (DOR).

steps.title: Find the official registration page
steps.detail: Search for '{state_name} Department of Revenue remote seller registration' or '{state_name} sales tax permit application'. Most states offer online registration.
common_pitfalls: Some states call it a 'Certificate of Authority', others a 'Sales Tax Permit' or 'Seller's Permit'. They are functionally equivalent.

steps.title: Gather required information
steps.detail: Typically needed: Federal EIN, LLC formation documents, responsible party SSN, business address, estimated sales volume, NAICS code.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.detail: Apply as a remote seller or out-of-state dealer. Indicate that you sell via marketplace (Amazon) and direct website (Shopify).
steps.verification_check: Receive a sales tax permit/certificate number.

steps.title: Note assigned filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Most states assign monthly, quarterly, or annual filing. Returns are typically due the 20th of the month following the reporting period. Some states require zero-filing even in months with no sales.

steps.title: Configure Shopify tax collection
steps.detail: Enable tax collection for this state in Shopify Admin > Settings > Taxes. Amazon handles marketplace orders.

steps.title: Update dashboard registrations
steps.detail: Mark the state as registered with correct frequency and due day. Generate filing calendar entries.

marketplace_facilitator_notes.title: Amazon Marketplace Facilitator — {state_name}
marketplace_facilitator_notes.summary: Amazon collects and remits sales tax on marketplace orders in all states with sales tax. This does not eliminate your registration or filing obligations if you have nexus.

steps.title: Amazon handles sales tax on Amazon orders
steps.detail: You do not owe additional sales tax on Amazon-facilitated orders.

steps.title: You may still need to register and file
steps.detail: If you have physical or economic nexus, registration may be required. Returns typically show Amazon-collected amounts as a deduction or marketplace facilitator line.

steps.title: Collect on Shopify/direct
steps.detail: You are responsible for collecting and remitting on direct (Shopify) orders.
